conventions.EWM: adjusted normalized weights decay**(target_index-1-history_index), with zero numerator/denominator initially; prior draw relative age0
conventions.MC: 10000 independent full69-draw uniform6-subset paths; refit each path from its first draw; replay identical fixed tie permutations
conventions.MC_rng: NumPy default_rng(20261029), independent from Python tie RNGs
conventions.attempt_count: unique known models tested on096-115; include fixed blocks and24-number pool; merge explore-blocks/canonical archive alias; exclude forward-only hypotheses, dissent, reserved H2, validation-only permutation
conventions.centroid_exclusion: exclude sorted position49; not forcibly number49 (Research says rank49)
conventions.history: expanding from26/047; predict before update; W20 is warmup, not a rolling window
conventions.multiplicity: raw MC p plus Bonferroni20 descriptive bound; do not claim complete-family Holm without old p-values; old failures must not be rerun
conventions.numeric: RESFOLD exact int64 common-denominator ordering; CENTROID/TAIL float64, no posthoc rounding or tolerance
conventions.p_values: plus-one upper tail for hits, lower tail for rank sums and score-midrank sums; (1+as_or_more_extreme)/(10000+1)
conventions.rank: actual ticket-order positions1..49; score midranks also reported
conventions.screen: 096-115 hits>=9 is exploratory screening only; fewer than9 disables the version
conventions.seeded_ties: independent random.Random(20261029) per seeded model; shuffle ascending1..49 once per scored target, stable score sort; no warmup RNG use
conventions.success: at least one ticket contains>=3 mains, count once per draw; special numbers ignored
conventions.tickets: first48 positions cut6;8 disjoint tickets; one remaining number excluded

SH-CENTROID-v1.score: negative absolute distance to normalized EWM of historical main-six means

SH-RESFOLD-v1.phase: CSV zero-based index i modulo P;26/047=0

SH-TAIL-v1.score: normalized EWM of main-six tail count divided by that tail's number count
